name: HBO Max
notes: Researched from public help.hbomax.com articles and the public hbomax.com plan page only (no sign-in; the sign-in form sits behind a terms/cookie consent dialog that was not accepted, so the email identifier is inferred). Subscriptions billed by WarnerMedia renew automatically to a US-issued card, Apple Pay or PayPal until canceled; there is no separate AutoPay, paper bill, guest pay or payment plan. Everything is managed on the Subscription page (Change Your Plan, Payment Method, Payment History, Cancel Your Subscription). Upgrades apply immediately with the price difference charged; downgrades and billing-period changes wait for the next billing date and can be undone with Cancel Pending Plan (the engine applies plan changes immediately). Cancel at least 24 hours before the next billing date. Subscribers billed by an app store or TV/internet provider manage the plan there. No installment plans; setup-payment-plan is suppressed. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa. pay-partial-card suppressed (fixer, streaming-subscriptions audit 2026-10-10): the membership is charged its plan price, which is below the generated $25.00 partial amount, so that task would be an overpayment; the service has no partial-payment option.

guest_pay.note: The subscription is charged to the payment method on your account; there is no bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: HBO Max renews automatically on each billing date and charges the payment method on file; there is nothing separate to enroll in.

autopay_cancel.note: Recurring charges stop only when you cancel the subscription.

paperless.note: No paper bills are mailed; receipts are listed under Payment History.

payment_arrangement.note: HBO Max charges the subscription price each billing period and does not offer installment plans.

cancel_service.note: Cancel at least 24 hours before your next billing date; you can stream until the paid period ends. App-store or provider-billed subscriptions are canceled with that company.

help.title: HBO Max plans and prices
paragraphs: Basic With Ads is $10.99 a month or $109.99 a year and streams on 2 devices in full HD. Standard is $18.49 a month or $184.99 a year, adds 30 downloads and live sports, and also streams on 2 devices.

Premium is $22.99 a month or $229.99 a year, with 4 streams at once, 4K video and Dolby Atmos where available, and 100 downloads. Yearly billing is paid upfront. Bundles with Disney+ and Hulu start at $21.99 a month.

help.title: Change your plan
steps: Sign in on a phone, tablet or computer.
Pick a plan and billing period and confirm.
paragraphs: Moving to a higher-priced plan happens right away: you pay the price difference and your next billing date is adjusted. Moving to a lower-priced plan, or only switching between monthly and yearly billing, takes effect on your next billing date. Until then you can undo it with Cancel Pending Plan. Current promotions end when the new plan starts. Only adult profiles can manage the subscription.

help.title: How to cancel HBO Max
steps: Go to the Subscription page and sign in.
Confirm and note your expiration date.
paragraphs: Your subscription renews automatically until you cancel; cancel at least 24 hours before the next billing date to avoid another charge. Deleting the app does not cancel. You keep streaming until the end of the paid period, get a confirmation email, and can choose Resume Your Subscription before then if you change your mind.

If there is no cancel option, the top of the Subscription page shows who bills you (an app store, or an internet, mobile or TV provider); cancel with them. An Extra Member Add-On ends with the base plan and its unused days are refunded pro rata.

help.title: Payment method and history
steps: Choose Payment Method to add or change how you pay, or Payment History to see receipts.
paragraphs: WarnerMedia-billed subscriptions accept American Express, Apple Pay, Discover, JCB, Mastercard, PayPal and Visa issued by a US bank that allow recurring online payments; some prepaid cards do not. For cards, the ZIP code and state must match the card billing address. A new payment method is used from your next charge.
